hook: NASA turned off three power-hungry devices on Voyager 1 before radio contact vanished for 48 hours.

sections.voiceover: NASA turned off three power-hungry devices on Voyager 1 before radio contact vanished for 48 hours.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of Voyager 1 spacecraft model against deep starfield background.
sections.sfx_cue: Deep space hum fading into a sharp radio static burst.
sections.animation_cue: Subtle zoom in on spacecraft telemetry dish.

sections.voiceover: Jet Propulsion Laboratory engineers completed a months-long power-stretching operation in September. Deep Space Network receivers detected no radio signal during scheduled checks on October 18 and October 19. Did Voyager 1 transmit its signal after 16 billion miles?
sections.visual_cue: Animated diagram showing Jet Propulsion Laboratory control room monitors and antenna tracking arcs.
sections.sfx_cue: Low digital pulsing tone indicating radar sweep.
b_roll: Deep Space Network antenna dish pointing at night sky
sections.animation_cue: Pulsing radar rings expanding outward from Earth.
sections.transition_out: Dissolve to deep space telemetry readout.

sections.voiceover: Then NASA faced a 48-hour communication pause on October 20 that resolved itself autonomously.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of telemetry screen showing signal lock recovering from red to green.
sections.sfx_cue: Crisp electronic chime confirming signal lock.
b_roll: Computer monitor displaying telemetry data graphs
sections.animation_cue: Waveform spiking back to active state.

sections.voiceover: Voyager 1 operated on three lower-power alternatives while sitting 24 billion kilometers from Earth.
sections.visual_cue: Wide cinematic view of Voyager 1 drifting through interstellar space past distant stars.
sections.sfx_cue: Resonant cosmic drone building in volume.
b_roll: Artist illustration of Voyager 1 in interstellar space
sections.animation_cue: Distance counter ticking up to 24 billion kilometers.

sections.voiceover: Silence across 16 billion miles of void ends in deep space.
sections.visual_cue: Distant view of Earth as a pale blue dot fading into the vast cosmos.
sections.sfx_cue: Gentle stellar wind sound fading into absolute silence.
b_roll: Pale blue dot photograph of Earth
sections.animation_cue: Camera pulling back infinitely into the starfield.
